## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build or release
- [ ] Security hardening

## Testing

- [ ] `mvnw.cmd clean verify` passes
- [ ] Example app builds with `mvnw.cmd -f examples\demo-app\pom.xml package`

## Security checklist

- [ ] No tokens, keys, passwords or sensitive replay data are included
- [ ] Changes to authentication, reflection, WebView, file writes or window actions are described below

## Additional context

Add screenshots, logs or replay plans if useful. Remove sensitive data first.
